item.title: Space Girl - Demo
item.description: A fast-paced movement shooter inspired by classic boomer shooters. Dash, master an arsenal of powerful weapons, uncover hidden secrets, and blast through hordes of enemies in a fast sci-fi adventure.

item.title: Regret - Demo
item.description: Regret is a stop-motion, top-down action roguelike where inventions from across history become your weapons. Battle through randomly generated dungeons in an entirely handmade world, craft powerful item combinations, and travel through time alone or with a friend in local co-op.

item.title: Adopt Me Please - Demo
item.description: Welcome to the Softlight Shelter. The animals are cute. The coffee is warm. Your job: vet the strays and find them a home. But keep your eyes open. Mimics are hiding in perfect pet disguises with Innocent eyes, waiting to get inside. Are you sheltering a pet... or a Mimic?

item.title: PLINKDOWN - Demo
item.description: It’s 1994 and Channel 9 is still on the air. Bounce orbs through peg boards, meet tonight’s quota, and spend what you earn at the Commissary between broadcasts. Every run goes deeper into a late-night show that should have stopped airing years ago.
